title: Riverbend Community Library: items borrowed by category, 2022-2024
bodyMd: The chart below shows the number of items borrowed from the Riverbend Community Library in each of three years, broken down into four categories. All figures are in thousands of items. Every item borrowed falls into exactly one of the four categories.

data.caption: Items borrowed from the Riverbend Community Library, in thousands, by category and year.

accessibilityText: A grouped bar chart showing items borrowed from the Riverbend Community Library, in thousands, for 2022, 2023 and 2024, in four categories. In 2022: print fiction 48, print nonfiction 32, audiobooks 12, digital titles 28, for a total of 120. In 2023: print fiction 45, print nonfiction 30, audiobooks 18, digital titles 42, for a total of 135. In 2024: print fiction 42, print nonfiction 27, audiobooks 27, digital titles 54, for a total of 150. Every borrowed item falls into exactly one category, so the four figures for a year add to that year's total.

provenance.notes: Original data interpretation set. The Riverbend Community Library is invented and every figure was constructed by the author to make the accompanying questions compute cleanly. Not drawn from any ETS material or any real library statistics.
